rule: owner decision 5e (2026-10-24): hard-core internal clock latency is compensated at the core clock pin. I = max over the core's flop-bearing clock ports of the mean sink insertion (ports with >= 2 sinks; SRAM single-sink macro clock ports listed but not counted). early_tap_ps = max(0, I - 250): the plan feeds the core clock pin that much earlier than the common 250 ps latency. Kit SDC: vclk source latency = contract_vclk_latency_ps = max(I, 250); tap_balance pads shorter ports up to it.
basis: ORFS CTS (SKIP_CTS_REPAIR_TIMING, POST_CTS tap_balance it0 = natural trees before padding), TT liberty (TC), placement RC (estimate_parasitics -placement), active rise edge, per clock port mean(min-max,sinks). Routed-RC values come with each kit's signoff (clock check insertion_pinflops).
